main.description: Get top locations by gallery count.

pins.description: Return every place carrying only what a map needs — name, h3Index, galleryCount — instead of the top 30 with thumbnails and cell lists. The full shape is ~1.1KB per place, so all of them would be ~780KB; lean it is ~70 bytes each.

h3Index.description: Canonical H3 cell for the place (densest cell in the group).

h3Cells.description: All H3 cells whose galleries map to this place. Ordered by gallery count desc.

thumbs.description: Up to four representative photo thumbnails, most recent first. Lets the index render without a feed request per location.
